titlStmt.titl: DDI Metadata for Sub-Saharan Africa Disease Incidence Dataset
Longitudinal Disease Incidence in Sub-Saharan Africa: Curated Indicators for HIV, Malaria, and Tuberculosis

stdyInfo.abstract: This curated dataset tracks HIV, Malaria, and Tuberculosis incidence across Sub-Saharan Africa from 2000 to 2025. Its purpose is to provide a reliable foundation for data-driven disease burden monitoring and epidemiological forecasting in the region.

dataColl.dataSrc: World Health Organization (WHO) Global Health Observatory
dataColl.collMode: Data files were downloaded in Excel format, filtered by indicator and country, and processed using Python.
dataColl.cleanOps: Rows restricted to 47 Sub-Saharan countries. Blank numeric fields converted to NA. New variables (MetricType, Denominator) derived from IndicatorCode.

useStmt.restrctn: Source data subject to WHO terms. Curation scripts and metadata licensed under MIT License.

var.name: IndicatorCode
var.txt: Unique identifier for the health indicator assigned by WHO.

var.name: Indicator
var.txt: Full descriptive name of the health indicator.

var.name: Location
var.txt: Name of the country or territory.

var.name: Period
var.txt: The year of the observation or estimate (2000-2025).

var.name: Dim1
var.txt: Sex or age group disaggregation if applicable.

var.name: FactValueNumeric
var.txt: The central numeric value of the observation.

invalnk.txt: Missing values are represented as NA.

var.name: FactValueUoM
var.txt: The unit corresponding to the numeric value.

var.name: FactValueNumericLow
var.txt: Lower bound of the uncertainty interval.

var.name: FactValueNumericHigh
var.txt: Upper bound of the uncertainty interval.

var.name: Value
var.txt: String representation of the value including bounds.

var.name: MetricType
var.txt: Distinguishes between incidence counts and incidence rates.

var.name: Denominator
var.txt: The denominator used if the metric is a rate (e.g., 1000 population at risk).
